She is visibly hiccupping, with a yellow text overlay at the top and Chinese subtitles at the bottom. The lighting is bright and natural from the window. Her expression fluctuates between slight distress from the hiccups and smiling as she engages in a conversation. She holds a smartphone briefly. The headrest behind her features a blue 'tiger' logo. (3) The camera stays in a selfie-style medium close-up as she laughs and reacts to the off-screen speaker. The editing consists of straightforward cuts between her different facial reactions as she continues to hiccup intermittently until the end of the video.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic sketch testing an urban legend that claims repeating 'I am not a fish' can stop hiccups. It uses a relatable situation (uncontrollable hiccups on a plane) to create humor when the solution fails.
